item_title: FTX founder Bankman-Fried says he is in the Bahamas
item_description: Angus Berwick / Reuters:  — FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried told Reuters on Saturday that he was in the Bahamas, denying speculation on Twitter that he had flown to South America after the exchange filed for bankruptcy and he was removed as chief executive.
